response.text:
I can help — but I need a few clarifications before I delete anything.

Uncertainty note: I’m not sure which exact date range you mean by “next week,” which calendar(s) to modify, or whether by “meetings” you mean any event with other attendees or every event on the calendar. I also don’t know whether you want deletions only from your view or full cancellations (sending cancel notices to attendees).

Please confirm the following (or tell me what you prefer):

1) Exact date range
   - I plan to interpret “next week” as Mon July 13–Sun July 19, 2026. Is that correct? If you mean a different range, tell me the start and end dates.

2) Which calendar(s)
   - Remove from: (a) my primary/work calendar, (b) personal calendar, (c) all calendars I have connected. Which?

3) What counts as a “meeting”
   - Remove only events that have other attendees (meetings), or remove all events (including personal appointments)? Confirm.

4) Deletion behavior
   - Options:
     A) Permanently delete events from your calendar (no notifications sent).
     B) Cancel meetings and send cancellation notices to attendees (recommended for group meetings).
     C) Decline invites but leave events for organizer to manage.
   - Which do you want?

5) Recurring events
   - For recurring meetings that occur next week, do you want to remove only the single occurrence(s) next week, or remove the whole recurring series?

6) Preview
   - Do you want me to show the list of events I’ll remove first for your approval before I take action?

Once you reply with these choices and explicitly confirm that I should proceed, I will carry out the requested deletions.
